title: Dialect
description: An analyzer output dialect of the raw device layer (ADR-0014, spec section 2.4.2): profile data in the style of ADR-0012. Every numeric parameter is {value, unit, ref} with ref a ledger id; modeled_on lists S### ids that must resolve; the banner line is required. A synthetic format modeled on public documentation, not a real instrument file. Labels are short field names from the ledger field lists (A160, A162, A165, A166, A168); no manual text is stored here.

banner.const: synthetic, modeled on public documentation; not a real instrument file
banner.description: The first line of every emitted file (ADR-0014 rule R3).

grain.description: What one data row is: one analysis of a sample, or one injection of a data system.

name_prefix.description: Vendor-neutral file-name prefix; the instrument id and the export time follow (A159).

units.description: Where the unit text sits: an optional units row under the header (RQ7) or in the header cell as 'Label (unit)'.

day_part_marker.description: A 12 h clock writes AM or PM; without it the stamp is ambiguous (RQ2).

zone.description: The stamp is local wall-clock text with no zone (RQ1).

means.description: Whether the row stamp is the start or the end of the run; the default, end, is an assumption (spec 2.4.8).

role.description: The raw role: sample_id, stamp, sample_time, dilution, injection_id, result_id, note, or analyte:<id>.

label.description: Header text: a short field name.

required.description: A required role missing from the header rejects the file (VR-023).

unit_text.description: The unit text of a value column as the device writes it by default (a key of units).

physical.description: The definitional bound of VR-006: no negative amount, a percent between 0 and 100, a pH on its scale.

units.description: Unit texts a device of this dialect may write, to a UCUM code and a dimension (A162 lists the options).

range_note.description: The note of an analytical-range breach reads '<analyte> Analytical Range <word>' (the CSV form is assumed, A163).
